modules.inputs: Song records; artist/title Unicode; used group keys; optional previous song ID
modules.outputs: Immutable Song, parsed artist/title, normalized group key, one eligible Song
modules.units: duration seconds; ID integer; no physical units otherwise
modules.frames: No spatial coordinates; Unicode whitespace/casefold identity
modules.precision: Exact integer identity and string equality; duration stored as float seconds from MP3 parser
modules.state: No persistent state; selection uses SystemRandom and persisted actual play history
modules.failure: ValueError when no eligible song; invalid filename returns empty artist for UI correction

bounds.capacity: O(N) song catalog scan and candidates memory; local music library scale; no retries or unbounded iteration
